formattedAddress: 100, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Aiguo Village, Aiguo W Rd, 50-4號一樓

text.text:
Update: this little cafe is under remodel and, from the looks of it, it will be a lot bigger.  Good luck, guys! Hope to see you soon.

I have found this little cafe 3 years ago online.  So the 1st thing I did coming back was heading here to have a bite and a chance to visit with kitty cats.  I have a grilled chicken sandwich, a pot of warm fruit tea (cold that day) and an egg pudding.  It was delicious!  One of the kitty cat came out to check out the diners.   He did not mingle much; he is quite aloof.  I was o lying able to snap a pix of him from a distance.

text.text:
Beautiful cafe with amazing service staff. Probably one of the most relaxing places I have eaten in my life. The food is great but the vibe is cozy.

Something very weird happened while I was eating. Three people pulled up in a car, double parked in the bike lane, then smoked cigarettes and threw them on the ground. I decided to confront them and ask why they are littering. They got angry and left. The service staff thanked me for standing up to them. I hope everyone can be mindful of how to properly discard their garbage and cigarettes.

Every single dish was delicious.
I could really feel the owner’s warmth and kindness.
I’ve heard that Taiwanese people are very kind, and now I know it’s true.
I’m leaving with a full and happy heart.
